annotations.title: Multi-chain gas and action cost oracle with AI pick

description: Fetch current EVM gas prices, EIP-1559 base/priority fees, and USD transfer estimates across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Optimism. Pass optional `chain` (`base`, `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, or `all`; defaults to `base`). Returns `gas_gwei`, `base_fee_gwei`, `priority_fee_gwei`, and `est_erc20_transfer_usd`. Do not use for Solana priority fees (use get_solana_priority_fee) or raw RPC calls (use call_chain_rpc). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.001 USDC).

action.description: What you plan to do (e.g. 'swap USDC to ETH')

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data

name: get_evm_gas_price
title: Multi-chain gas and action cost oracle with AI pick
